updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.8.0
updateTo.notes:
Adds a US price guide in USD before shipping and tax to every lens page: new retail, the highest observed top-condition asking price, and the used asking-price average, median and range.
Includes seven checked Sigma model/mount snapshots and 47 observed offers. Seller grades, source links, sample size, limited coverage and the date checked stay visible. An unavailable or unverified offer does not enter an average.
Check current prices uses the connected ChatGPT plan with a focused low-effort lookup. Completed results require exact model/mount data and opened source links. Stop and failed requests preserve the previous saved prices.
Saved prices work offline and appear in lens PDFs. Successful refreshes also save a dated copy in the connected lens folder when available. Prices remain separate from optical measurements and research history.
New, open-box, like-new used, ordinary used, historical MSRP and verified completed sales remain distinct. Observations older than seven days invite a recheck; those older than 30 days are marked historical.
Resumes Sigma collection after approval of the five 0.7.2 lens pages. The selected 12–24mm F4 HSM Art full-size gallery is now verified in the private library; archived material still needs its own finished lens assessment. Preserves in-app updates and existing lens pages.

Price samples are observed asking offers, not a valuation or a complete market survey. Stock and prices may change. eBay sold prices and MSRP appear only when independently verified; neither was established in the bundled snapshots.
Some lenses have no available new stock or no verified offer. Online refresh depends on the ChatGPT connection and source availability; websites may block automated reading. There is no paid API-key billing in this app.
Publisher originals stay in the private Proton Drive library and are not included in the installer. Keep them downloaded locally for offline images.
Development-signed personal preview; Apple notarization remains pending.

updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.7.2
updateTo.notes:
Adds complete offline pages for Sigma 20mm F1.4, 24mm F1.4, 85mm F1.4 and 135mm F1.8 DG HSM Art, plus 56mm F1.4 DC DN Contemporary (Sony E). Open Offline collection, choose Sigma, then open a lens.
The five pages contain nine charts, 35 illustrated findings and 59 selected evidence images, with specifications, strengths, compromises and a practical Focal Lab conclusion. Each page can be exported as a PDF.
Redraws four LensTip resolution graphs with explicit approximation tolerances and transcribes the exact OpticalLimits 56mm table. Camera, units, native/corrected behaviour and source discrepancies remain separate.
Links the three previously missing catalogue identities to their personal archives. The catalogue now contains 978 lens/mount entries; correction profiles and wider reference counts are unchanged.
Fixes collection of charts from newer LensTip image folders. Original reviews, diagnostic images and full-size galleries stay in the organized personal Proton Drive library.
Preserves the approved 40mm and 105mm pages, saved work, Focal Lab default priorities and the in-app updater. Wider collection is paused for review of these five pages.

Publisher originals are personal library files and are not included in the installer. Keep the connected Proton Drive files downloaded locally for offline images.
The 56mm resolution-test camera is not explicitly identified by its selected source. Qualitative assessments are not universal numerical rankings; approximate chart readings remain labelled.
Development-signed personal preview; Apple notarization remains pending.

updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.7.1
updateTo.notes:
The Sigma 40 mm and 105 mm examples now end with illustrated findings: selected original images, what to look for, and what each strength or compromise means in practice.
Seven visual findings per lens cover detail, color fringing and focus shift, background blur, point lights, corner brightness, flare and autofocus. Each image keeps its source and test context and can be enlarged.
The full photo gallery and original reviews are kept in an expandable archive. The concise visual conclusion is also included in lens and research PDF exports.
Measurements and test conditions show useful supplied values and omit empty, unknown and inapplicable rows. Original saved evidence remains unchanged.
The updated Sigma comparison is saved as a new example; existing research history, in-app updates and Focal Lab default priorities are preserved.

Selected images illustrate documented findings; a single photograph cannot establish autofocus speed or reliability. Test differences remain explicit.
The Digital Picture interactive alternatives and linked full-size galleries remain incomplete. Wider downloading stays on hold while these two examples are reviewed.
Development-signed personal preview; Apple notarization remains pending.

updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.7.0
updateTo.notes:
Offline collection opens with brand filters and one row per lens name and generation, grouping its mount variants. The lens catalogue opens the same lens pages.
Each lens page brings together saved charts, specifications, Focal Lab assessments, source agreements and disagreements, local photographs, review chapters, correction data and a practical conclusion.
Browse approved personal source images by publisher and section, read saved review text inside the app and export the consolidated lens page as a PDF. Files are checked locally against their recorded checksums.
The Sigma 40 mm and 105 mm pages contain a source-based Focal Lab conclusion. New research requests explain how each source supports the assessment and keep unresolved conflicts visible. Preferences affect suitability, not source credibility.
Collection counts now explain the difference between lens/mount entries, correction records and the wider unmerged specification references. Dynamic link checks detect missing or mismatched records.
Preserves in-app updates, saved comparisons, research history and Focal Lab default priorities. No wider publisher collection is started by this update.

Lens pages show available evidence; many lenses have only partial measurements or correction data. This does not certify all 16,454 reference records.
The Digital Picture archives contain the main reviews and default images. Interactive alternatives and linked full-size galleries remain incomplete.
Development-signed personal preview; Apple notarization remains pending.

updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.6.8
updateTo.notes:
Offline collection only shows Open this lens’s files when that exact lens has an indexed, accessible local folder.
Lenses with saved charts but no photo or review archive now show Not downloaded yet and a link to the original source. Chart and number downloads remain available.
Choosing a library folder refreshes availability immediately. Missing folders and unreadable indexes show a reconnect message instead of a misleading download status.
Preserves the Sigma 40 mm and 105 mm example, personal library files, research history and the in-app updater. Wider collecting remains paused for example review.

This update corrects file availability labels; it does not download additional lens archives.
Development-signed personal preview; Apple notarization remains pending.

updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.6.7
updateTo.notes:
Open the Sigma 40 mm and 105 mm example from Research, with eight-aperture center and edge charts, source-linked specifications, strengths, tradeoffs and a practical conclusion.
Read approved source pictures from your chosen local library, with attribution and checksum checks. Originals stay in your library and are not included in GitHub releases.
Research requests now ask for individual lens guides and qualitative assessments for all five optical categories. Numerical charts retain the original metric, units, conditions and uncertainty.
Download the complete report as a PDF, including available local illustrations and the measurement table.
Offline collection separates measured data, reference specifications and correction profiles. Lensfun distortion coefficients have readable model curves and optional technical details.
Reusable, paced collection and browser-import scripts support future brands without AI service calls. Wider downloading is held until the example is reviewed.
Preserves the repaired in-app updater, existing signing identity, research history and Focal Lab default priorities.

The example graph readings are approximate, with a separate digitization tolerance; they are not a new laboratory test.
Publisher illustrations require the chosen personal library folder to remain available locally. Future reports depend on the evidence available for the selected lenses.
Development-signed personal preview; Apple notarization remains pending.

updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.6.6
updateTo.notes:
Research automatically adapts to your selected lenses. Choose Automatic, Same focal length or Different focal lengths; the chosen approach is saved with each report.
Reports open with a clear conclusion and next step. Internal lens codes are replaced with lens names, citations are readable links, and supporting detail is separated from the main answer.
Research and comparison PDFs include charts from saved numerical measurements, with source labels, units, missing-value gaps and separate test conditions.
Reports without numerical measurements explain why no performance chart can be drawn. Older reports with a focal-length mismatch show a simple setup diagram.
Retains Focal Lab default priorities, evidence validation, saved history, PDF downloads and the repaired in-app updater from 0.6.5.

Different focal lengths change framing; results describe tradeoffs and fit rather than a controlled same-focal-length optical ranking.
Charts require actual saved numerical measurements. Existing reports are preserved; run Research again to obtain a new comparison.
Development-signed personal preview; Apple notarization remains pending.

updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.6.5
updateTo.notes:
Fixes the Invalid package error while extracting the downloaded application inside Focal Lab.
Preserves the complete signed application, verifies its developer signature and download integrity, then replaces and restarts the Applications copy.
Retains saved work, sign-in, research report delivery and Download PDF from Research, History and comparison exports.
Updates are tested from the packaged Mac app through extraction, signature verification, replacement and restart.

Versions through 0.6.4 require one direct installation of 0.6.5 because their installed updater cannot extract the new application. Future updates use Download and restart.
Development-signed personal preview; Apple notarization remains pending.

updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.6.4
updateTo.notes:
Retains completed streamed report items when the service omits them from its final completion message. Interrupted or unfinished streams remain rejected.
Separates model progress messages from the final structured answer so commentary does not invalidate a completed research report.
Download PDF from a completed research report or its History entry, with findings, saved priorities, limitations, source links and numerical extractions.
Export comparisons as PDFs from the comparison export menu. PDF exports work locally without starting another research request.
Preserves report validation, unreviewed evidence status, Focal Lab default priorities and the existing Mac signing identity.

Research depends on service availability and a valid complete response; incomplete reports remain rejected.
Development-signed personal preview; Apple notarization remains pending.

updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.6.3
updateTo.notes:
Recognizes completed research streams even when the connection omits the response format header; incomplete or invalid reports remain rejected.
Research now shows connection, waiting, search and report stages based on actual progress.
Failed, stopped and interrupted requests remain in History with their outcome; errors also remain visible on the Research page.
Completed streamed reports no longer wait for connection cleanup before returning. Stop also works when a response stream is silent.
Manual installation now uses Finder to avoid the temporary app location that caused the 0.6.2 installer to roll back.
Preserves Focal Lab default sliders, Optical Protocol 1.1, saved work and the development signing identity.

This update improves result delivery and diagnostics. It cannot guarantee research service availability or account eligibility.
For manual installation, quit Focal Lab and use Finder to move Focal Lab.app into your existing Applications folder, replacing the earlier copy. Open that Applications copy.
Development-signed personal preview; Apple notarization remains pending.

updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.6.2
updateTo.notes:
Signed the personal Mac preview with a consistent Apple development identity.
Installation and future updates preserve the release signature instead of replacing it with a temporary local signature.
Updates verify the expected Focal Lab developer identity before replacing the app.
Includes the repaired GitHub downloader from 0.6.1 and all research priority sliders.

Install this version once from Open downloads to establish the new signing identity; versions through 0.6.1 replace preview signatures during updates.
macOS may request one Keychain approval when moving to the new identity. Ordinary restarts should retain that approval.
This personal development preview is not a notarized Developer ID release.
Live ChatGPT research still depends on account eligibility and service availability.

updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.6.1
updateTo.notes:
Fixed the “Redirect was cancelled” error when downloading GitHub updates on macOS.
Kept the configured repository, allowed redirect host, archive-size check and SHA-256 verification for every update.
Includes all 0.6.0 features: five research priority sliders, Focal Lab default, editing preferences and saved report priorities.
Updated the manual installation instructions for existing Mac installations.

Versions 0.5.1 and 0.6.0 need this one-time repair from Open downloads: quit Focal Lab, extract the 0.6.1 ZIP, and open Install_Focal_Lab.command. The installer preserves the workspace and replaces the existing application.
Personal preview: Apple Developer ID signing and notarization remain pending.
Live ChatGPT research depends on account eligibility and service availability.

updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.6.0
updateTo.notes:
Added five research sliders, starting with Focal Lab default. Adjust sharpness, aberration control, bokeh, flare, and distortion / corner brightness without entering percentages.
Added an editing preference for lens corrections, keeping native and corrected findings distinct.
Custom priorities guide best-fit research while preserving original measurements, evidence requirements, and uncertainty.
Saved priorities with each research report and separated cached results when priorities change. New lens selections start with Focal Lab default.
Kept the default 50 / 20 / 15 / 10 / 5 optical priorities and added a one-click reset. Updates remain available through Download and restart.
